name: Tsujii Arisa
source:
A first-year student who is chasing after Saki.
She and Saki have been childhood friends since elementary school.
Although they are seen as good friends by others, in reality, Arisa is just following her around one-sidedly.

She admires her feminine proportions and personality, and she adores her from the bottom of his heart.
sHe is also a black hearted person, and her interests are mostly focused on Saki, and she does not care about anything else.
She is aware of his cuteness, and uses it to her advantage to take advantage of others.
